name: @noryx/auth-core
description: Milestone 3.2 Stage 1 — the single shared implementation of JWT verification and RBAC role-checking used by every Noryx service (Identity, Finance, API Gateway). Centralizes the JwtStrategy/JwtAuthGuard/RolesGuard/Roles()/Public() mechanism that was previously three independent, drifting implementations (docs/hardening/milestone-3.2-proposal.md §8 gap 4). Authentication *workflows* — login, refresh, logout, token issuance, credential handling — remain services/identity's responsibility; this package holds only the reusable authorization *mechanism*.
